definitions.gloss: northern part; the north (of a region or country)
definitions.explanation: The northern area of a country, region, city or other area.

examples.english: The northern part of the prefecture.
Snow is expected in the north.

examples.japanese: ⟦イタリア→イタリア：19423_itaria⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{北部|ほくぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{工業|こうぎょう}→工業：01402_kougyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧で、⟦{南部|なんぶ}→南部：31707_nanbu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Northern Italy is highly industrial and differs from the south in both climate and culture.

notes:
Common in weather forecasts and news: ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧{北部|ほくぶ} (northern Kantō), ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧{北部|ほくぶ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{北部|ほくぶ}: the north of …
- {北部|ほくぶ}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧: the northern region
- {北部|ほくぶ}{山沿|やまぞ}い: the northern mountain areas (weather forecasts)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{南部|なんぶ}→南部：31707_nanbu⟧: the south
- ⟦{東部|とうぶ}→東部：32584_toubu⟧: the east
- ⟦{西部|せいぶ}→西部：32585_seibu⟧: the west
